description.zh: 把工程请求整理成团队模板，保留显式约束和验收方式。
description.en: Organizes engineering requests into a team template with explicit constraints and acceptance.

guidance.zh: 一句话说明要完成的变更。
guidance.en: State the change in one sentence.

guidance.zh: 只列用户点名的文件、模块和符号。
guidance.en: List only files, modules, and symbols named by the user.

guidance.zh: 保留必须、不要、只能等原始约束。
guidance.en: Preserve must, must-not, and only constraints verbatim.

guidance.zh: 只写用户提供的测试或验收方式。
guidance.en: Include only tests or acceptance criteria supplied by the user.
List missing information as open questions.
